description: Open a serial port that device.list reports and stream what it sends. RTS and DTR are switched off, so the board is neither held in reset nor put in download mode. Returns a subscription: serial.data events carry the bytes, serial.closed says when the port went away. core.unsubscribe closes the port, as does closing the connection.

reconnect.description: Since protocol 0.26. When the port goes away, send serial.lost and open it again once it is back (for 30 s), then serial.reconnected; serial.closed only if it does not come back. For boards that reset over their own USB, and for plugging a board back in. Default false.

expect.description: Since protocol 0.28: a library project id. Check what the board prints against that project's expected output (the manifest's expect): serial.expect events, timed by the project's seconds plus five, from the open and from each reconnection. Absent: no check.
